initialFailure.cause: Starting placement unnecessarily reset an already editable view. Canvas needed another frame before safe picking, so the stale-view guard ignored a premature first click.
initialFailure.fix: preparePick preserves existing editable Globe/Net views and exits immersive inspection only when needed. The stale-view guard remains intact. Both failing Canvas cases and the final full matrix passed.

contracts.hole: Independent v1 circular-radial ThroughHole with separate mouth identities, real radial sphere/capsule bore clipped by two spherical reference surfaces; no network nodes.
contracts.views: Physical subtraction in Outside Globe and read-only View from inside. Inside editing overview and Net show exact mouth markers; physical-cut controls explain this limit.
contracts.protection: Level 0 m support on both banks, conservative 4*pi*surfaceRadius/N padding. Whole dabs and whole history replays validate before any write or stack mutation.
contracts.persistence: v9 exact banks, immutable World/surface IDs, hole objects, selected role and bounded connection journal, all checksummed and guarded before promotion. Explicit same-geometry v8-to-v9 upgrade; v1-v8 meanings preserved.
contracts.limits: Hole radius >= Rout*1e-5 and <= min(Rin*.1,thickness*.25); thickness >= Rout*1e-4. Thin Worlds remain editable with a clear unavailable-hole explanation. No displaced terrain excavation.

qualifications: Browser input is trusted CDP mouse/pen/touch and Pixel 7 emulation, not physical-device or human acceptance.
Browser groups overlap; counts are not summed as unique cases.
Each long case injects 900 moves over 15 seconds. Chromium can coalesce them before trusted pointer dispatch; both counts are recorded. No editor-side input is dropped.
First changed terrain pixels are sampled at 100 ms cadence; coherent-drain timings are not per-input first-visible latency.

Memory subtotal includes banks, two prepared field caches, connection words, support masks and one hole journal entry. It excludes terrain histories, active GPU/canvas resources, transient snapshots, workers and process/driver overhead.
Sphere tunnel graphs, reciprocal links and hollow/open cylinders are not implemented in this checkpoint. They remain authorized next work.
No website, server, shared database, Docker or Production changes; historical receipts and screenshot evidence remain intact.
